convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorAML indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trading operations (open/close positions, money management, new bar detection, history loading). The custom indicator and library must be ported or reimplemented.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator calculation

other_exits: Sell position closed when ColorAML buffer value becomes 2 (buy signal)
Buy position closed when ColorAML buffer value becomes 0 (sell signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 means 0.1 lots), positive values treated as deposit fraction for money management handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads ColorAML buffer 1 values at positions SignalBar and SignalBar+1. Value==2 at bar[SignalBar+1] with Value!=2 at bar[SignalBar] confirms a fresh buy signal (color change to uptrend). Value==0 at bar[SignalBar+1] with Value!=0 at bar[SignalBar] confirms a fresh sell signal (color change to downtrend). The intermediate value 1 appears to represent a neutral/no-signal zone. If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick without waiting for a new bar. The Recount flag forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. Position close logic is permission-gated: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose booleans control whether opposite-side closes occur on reversal signals.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorAML custom indicator must be ported to Python first - its buffer 1 returns discrete values (0=downtrend, 1=neutral, 2=uptrend). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution including money management (MM parameter), position opening/closing with deviation control, and new bar detection - these must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so verify point-to-pip conversion for the target symbol. The conditional MM logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) must be carefully replicated. Signal bar indexing uses CopyBuffer with offset SignalBar, reading 2 consecutive values to detect color transitions.
